sources.title: Michałowice ruling OŚ.6220.18.2023: planned Reguły service complex 3, 2 October 2026

sources.title: Michałowice EIA requirement OŚ.6220.18.2023, 4 September 2026

sources.summary: The public school reports participating in the achieved inauguration of the OneCloud startup data centre in Akbou, attended by the minister. The school is an event participant and cooperation partner, not the data-centre operator. No capacity, full cloud-service rollout or original construction completion date is established.

The text says today; the participating sponsor Ooredoo independently dates the achieved inauguration to 1 October. Status is recorded as of this later 2 October report, without treating the publication day as the ceremony day.

sources.title: OneCloud operator page: Akbou data centre and phased service rollout

It describes owned data-centre infrastructure and local cloud services, with October 2026 pilot, January 2027 national rollout and later regional rollout. Accreditation and certification are still pending.
sources.date_semantics: Undated page. Month-level pilot labels and current marketing are context only and do not provide a new exact-day physical observation.

sources.title: Ooredoo reports OneCloud Akbou data-centre inauguration on 1 October 2026
sources.summary: Participating event sponsor Ooredoo directly reports that the 1 October Akbou forum included the inauguration of the first local OneCloud data centre. This corroborates the completed-facility milestone and gives a primary ceremony date. It does not establish full commercial operations, capacity or a different facility location.
sources.date_semantics: Visible original press-release date 2026-10-01 and body explicitly identify the achieved event on Thursday 1 October 2026. The ESTIN participant report followed on 2 October.
